title: Towards Order Fairness: Mitigating LLMs Order Sensitivity through Dual Group Advantage Optimization
authors: Xu Chu; Guanyu Wang; Zhijie Tan; Xinrong Chen; Ziyu Li; Tong Mo; Weiping Li
why_relevant: Addresses LLM order sensitivity in RAG contexts, proposes an RL method (DGAO) to improve robustness to passage ordering, and introduces Consistency/Overconfidence metrics relevant to evaluating RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Order bias is only one facet of unreliable evidence; not centrally about noisy/conflicting/adversarial retrieval.
suggested_section: Distraction and positional sensitivity in RAG
